evaluation.overall_comment: A high-quality, scientifically rigorous translation that successfully transfers a specialized physics podcast into Galician. It excels in technical accuracy and information preservation, maintaining an appropriate academic yet accessible tone. The main detractors are a few noticeable lexical/typographical errors ('exemplo', 'átonos') and minor literalisms that slightly compromise natural flow. Despite these, the text remains highly effective, coherent, and well-suited for its intended Galician-speaking scientific audience. With minor proofreading to correct the glaring vocabulary slips, it would reach excellent native-level quality.
